definition: A metric that measures the similarity between two vectors by computing the cosine of the angle between them, commonly used to compare embeddings.
details: Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1 and is widely used in semantic search and recommendation systems because it captures directional similarity independent of vector magnitude.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. That shared ruler is Cosine Similarity.
